title: All The Instruments (World Fusion Instrumental)
style: world fusion pure instrumental mbira koto sitar marimba oud djembe kora accordion 82bpm warm multicultural no vocals cinematic atmospheric all nations textural layered global
lyrics:
[Instrumental — all world instruments layering in sequence]

[Opening — mbira alone, Zimbabwe]

[Koto enters — Japan, over mbira]

[Sitar joins — India, three cultures together]

[Marimba adds — Nicaragua, four cultures]

[Oud enters — Arabic world, five cultures]

[Djembe rounds — West Africa, six]

[Full world texture — all playing together]

[Marimba and mbira alone — close]

[Single mbira note — fade]
